rationale.table_4: Transplacental distribution: lorazepam concentrations in cord blood and maternal blood, with a concentration ratio — drug concentrations in biological matrices. INCLUDED.

oracle_kind: semantic (LLM selection judgment). The CI test asserts the oracle is internally consistent (selected/excluded partition every table, disjoint, all labels real) and that the bundled converter renders every table into the Stage-0a `00_all_tables.md` input. The actual select-vs-exclude decision is a model eval, run per the README.
